{"title":"Build Nexus Analytics Seed Investor Pitch Deck","content":"## Plan Overview

With all critical data now collected (P&L Jan-Oct 2024, sales pipeline Q4 2024, business plan sections, team details, unit economics), we can proceed to build a compelling seed-stage investor deck for Nexus Analytics. The approach is to:

1. **Research best-in-class seed pitch decks and SaaS pricing market data** to inform structure, benchmarks, and market sizing
2. **Build the financial model and projections** from the P&L and pipeline data
3. **Draft the full narrative deck content** (slide-by-slide copy, talking points)
4. **Create the PowerPoint presentation** with professional design
5. **Synthesize and deliver** final materials with investor-ready PDF

Since the user cannot upload files and we have all data in-context, we'll work from the pasted data. Key metrics to highlight: 300% YoY ARR growth ($140K→$420K), 82% gross margins, 13x LTV:CAC, 92% retention, 11-month payback, world-class founding team (ex-Stripe, Databricks, Gong), $8B TAM.

We still need the remaining business plan sections (competitive landscape, GTM, pricing model, roadmap, ask amount).
